svg.title: Reported and projected average source power vs wavelength
svg.desc: Average power versus wavelength for 51 sourced light-source rows from 5 to 250 nm: tin plasma in production at 13.5 nm near the shaded 250 W to 1 kW need, accelerator designs above it, synchrotron, FEL, HHG and soft-X-ray lasers far below, ArF and KrF lasers at 30–120 W.
